_comment: Hand-curated; every entry cites a change record whose Introduced-in field was checked (cr_info.py).

entries.name: OOP hook implementations with #[Hook]
entries.summary: Hooks are methods on autowired service classes marked with the #[Hook] attribute, instead of procedural functions in .module files. Classes live in src/Hook/.
entries.notes: Procedural implementations still work; #[LegacyHook] lets a module keep a procedural fallback for older core.

entries.name: #[ReorderHook] attribute
entries.summary: Reorder hook implementations of other modules (before/after) from a hook class.

entries.name: #[RemoveHook] attribute
entries.summary: Remove another module's hook implementation from a hook class.

entries.name: OOP hooks in themes
entries.summary: Themes can implement hooks as #[Hook] class methods instead of procedural functions in the .theme file.

entries.name: PHP attributes for plugin definitions
entries.summary: Plugin types and plugin implementations declare their metadata with PHP attributes (for example #[Block], #[FieldType], #[Action]) instead of docblock annotations.
entries.notes: CR 3395582 covers defining new plugin types with attributes. Core converted its own plugin types in 10.3.0 (CR 3229001), 11.1.0 (CR 3505422, entity types) and 11.2.0 (CR 3505424).

entries.name: Plugin managers prefer attributes over annotations
entries.summary: DefaultPluginManager reads the attribute before the annotation when both exist, so a plugin can carry both during migration.

entries.name: Service autowiring
entries.summary: Services can be autowired by type-hinted constructor arguments (autowire: true) without listing arguments in services.yml.

entries.name: AutowireTrait for controllers and forms
entries.summary: Controllers and other ContainerInjectionInterface classes can use AutowireTrait so create() is not needed to inject services.

entries.name: Autowired controllers
entries.summary: Controllers can be autowired and a create() method is no longer always necessary.

entries.name: Core services provide autowiring aliases
entries.summary: Core services have class and interface aliases so they resolve by type hint.

entries.name: PluginBase::create() with autowired parameters
entries.summary: Plugins get a default create() that autowires constructor parameters.

entries.name: FormBase::create() with autowired parameters
entries.summary: Forms get a default create() that autowires constructor parameters.

entries.name: #[Required] setter injection
entries.summary: AutowireTrait supports setter injection with the #[Required] attribute.

entries.name: Recipes
entries.summary: Recipes are composable, declarative packages of config, content and module installs applied with a recipe.yml file. The Recipe API shipped as experimental in 10.3.0.
entries.notes: Experimental in 10.3.0. The 11.1.0 release notes and later change records treat recipes as supported, but no single change record marks stabilisation, so no stable version is claimed.

entries.name: Recipe inputs
entries.summary: Recipes accept input at the command line.

entries.name: Recipe Unpack Composer plugin
entries.summary: Composer plugin that unpacks a recipe's dependencies into the project composer.json.

entries.name: Single Directory Components (SDC)
entries.summary: Components live in one directory (Twig, YAML metadata, CSS, JS) under components/ in a module or theme and render with include or embed of a provider:component name. Experimental module in 10.1.0.
entries.notes: The change record 3355112 added SDC as an experimental module in 10.1.0; 3410260 made it stable and part of core in 10.3.0.

entries.name: SDC component variants
entries.summary: Components can declare variants.

entries.name: SDC components as form elements
entries.summary: Single Directory Components can be used as form elements.

entries.name: HTMX in core
entries.summary: The AJAX subsystem includes HTMX; core provides an HTMX renderer and a route option for routes that serve HTMX requests.
entries.notes: CR 3547745 adds the route option and CR 3549174 a trait for building render arrays for HTMX, both also in 11.3.0.

entries.name: PHP attributes for routes
entries.summary: Controller methods define routes with the #[Route] attribute instead of a routing.yml file.

entries.name: Bundle classes
entries.summary: Entity bundles map to their own PHP classes, so node, media and other entity bundles can carry bundle-specific code.
entries.notes: The Bundle attribute for declaring and discovering bundle classes arrives in 11.4.0 (CR 3574891).

entries.name: #[Bundle] attribute for bundle classes
entries.summary: Bundle classes declared with Drupal\Core\Entity\Attribute\Bundle are discovered without hook_entity_bundle_info_alter().

entries.name: core/once library
entries.summary: JavaScript behaviors attach once-only logic with once() from the core/once library, without jQuery.

entries.name: Starterkit theme generator
entries.summary: Generate a new theme from core/themes/starterkit with core/scripts/drupal generate-theme instead of subthemeing Classy.

entries.name: #config_target in ConfigFormBase
entries.summary: Config forms bind elements to config keys with #config_target and validate with config validation constraints.

entries.name: file.validator service
entries.summary: File validation uses the file.validator service and constraint plugins instead of file_validate_* functions.

entries.name: PHPUnit attributes in tests
entries.summary: Core tests can use PHPUnit 10 attributes instead of @group-style annotations.
